text:
pagerbot: AUTO-PAGER -> PagerDuty incident PD-73421 fired for service=inference-gateway (severity: high). Symptoms: sustained 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings in ap-southeast-1. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-73421 :rotating_light:

jen: acked and taking this one. pinging infra and auth-proxy owners.

liam: looking at metrics — 5xx started ~09:02 UTC, error rate spiked to ~42% for the embeddings route, p95 latency also up.

devon: seeing a flood of upstream 502 from auth-proxy in the logs. sample:
```
2026-03-18T09:03:14Z auth-proxy[pid=2134]: upstream_resp status=502 upstream=auth-service (10.12.3.7) err="connection reset by peer"
```

nikhil: any recent deploys or config pushes to ap-southeast-1?

ops-bot: deploy history query: no deploys to inference-gateway in ap-southeast-1 in the last 2 hours. (runbook-check OK)

jen: ok starting triage per runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeddings-5xx. Step 1: validate health of auth-service pool and backends. Step 2: reduce LB weight for embeddings route to limit blast radius.

liam: curl health check against auth-service shows intermittent 502s:
```
$ curl -i https://auth-internal.ap-southeast-1.svc/health
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: kong
X-Error: upstream read ECONNRESET
```

devon: I can flip a canary routing rule. Suggest move 70% of embeddings traffic to fallback-serving (dedicated cpu pool) while we stabilise auth-proxy.

jen: doing weight update now: set-route-weight --service embeddings --region ap-southeast-1 --route /v1/embeddings --weight 30
ops-bot: route weight change applied (change-id: ch_0a9f).

liam: monitoring — error rate dropped from 42% -> 9% within 2 minutes after weight change. p95 latency still elevated but trending down.

jen: confirming no other alerts correlated. Checking customer impact: small subset of requests failed (mostly batched embeddings >2k tokens). No large-scale degradation observed in host apps.

nikhil: please draft a short note for status page if we hit >10% or 15+ min unresolved.

jen: agreed. will prepare. continuing investigation into auth-proxy: looks like recent library bump changed keepalive behaviour causing upstream resets under concurrent long-lived connections.

liam: stack trace snippet from auth-proxy pod:
```
E 09:04:02 http: read tcp 10.12.3.7:443->10.12.5.9:52034: read: connection reset by peer
E 09:04:03 runtime: netpoll failed to reuse fd
```

devon: can we quick-patch auth-proxy config (increase keepalive_timeout to 120s) and restart 1/3 pods? That should reduce handshake churn.

jen: applying quick config change + rolling restart (1/3) in ap-southeast-1 now. command: kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy --max-unavailable=1 --selector=region=ap-southeast-1
ops-bot: rollout started for deploy/auth-proxy (rollout-id r_22f).

liam: after restart and keepalive increase, observed connection resets drop sharply. error rate back to baseline ~0.7% over 5m.

jen: mitigation successful. Rolling back the temporary traffic weight to normal (100%) gradually to validate: set-route-weight ... --weight 100 -> verifying.

ops-bot: route weight restored. ch_0a9f -> closed.

jen: monitoring for 15 more minutes per runbook. No PD auto-escalation pending.

nikhil: thanks team. any customer comms? We will hold until we confirm stable for 15m; then post a short note: "Brief surge of 5xx on embeddings endpoint in ap-southeast-1; mitigation applied, service stable. Follow-up with details to come."

pagerbot: PD incident PD-73421 acknowledged by jen. Auto-escalation canceled.

jen: marking as resolved after 18 minutes. Followup: postmortem assigned to @devon (auth-proxy) and @liam (serving infra). Action items: add keepalive regression test to CI, pick backport patch for auth-proxy lib bump, update runbook with a traffic-weight rollback checklist.

nikhil: please tag affected customers if we find any request-level failures during postmortem.

jen: will file postmortem draft and link to this thread. closing thread now. :white_check_mark:
